user.title: Add a Plant
user.description: Configure a plant to monitor. Moisture and light are required; temperature and humidity are optional but improve happiness scoring.

data_description.plant_name: A friendly name for this plant, e.g. 'Monstera' or 'Kitchen Basil'
data_description.moisture_entity: Soil moisture reported as a percentage (0 = bone dry, 100 = saturated)
data_description.light_entity: Ambient light as a percentage or in lux — the unit is detected automatically
data_description.temperature_entity: Ambient temperature — any unit, HA will convert automatically

plantbook.title: Open PlantBook (optional)
plantbook.description:
Connect to [Open PlantBook](https://open.plantbook.io) to pull species-specific care thresholds. Leave blank to use built-in generic defaults.

Create a free API account at https://open.plantbook.io/apikey/show/ to get your credentials.

data_description.plantbook_client_id: Client ID from your Open PlantBook API account
data_description.plantbook_client_secret: Client Secret from your Open PlantBook API account
data_description.plant_species: Scientific or common name used to look up this plant, e.g. 'monstera deliciosa' or 'peace lily'

error.moisture_required: A soil moisture sensor is required.
error.invalid_entity: One or more selected entities could not be found.

abort.already_configured: A plant with this name is already configured.
